en: A colorized historic street scene showing an urban square leading into a long straight street lined with multi‑story stone buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the open space, while shopfronts occupy the ground floors. Ornate street lamps and a small fenced planted area appear in the foreground. The caption at the top in German identifies the view as looking from Postplatz into Gaschwitzerstraße in Bautzen.
